2006.why: It drew about one and a half times the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about lights.
2006.pln: about one and a half times the average car's complaints
td: Lights
Walk around with the lights on: headlights, taillights, brake lights and turn signals.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Speed control
It should accelerate and hold speed smoothly, with no surging; try the cruise control.

2007.why: It drew a bit more than the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about body structure.
2007.pln: a bit more than the average car's complaints
td: Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Wipers & visibility
Run the wipers, washers, defrost and mirror controls.
Speed control
It should accelerate and hold speed smoothly, with no surging; try the cruise control.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.

2008.pln: complaints only, too few sold to score
td: Seats

Fuel system

td: Speed control

Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Suspension
Drive over bumps: listen for clunks or rattles, and look for uneven tire wear.
Tires
Check the tread is even across each tire, with no bulges, and note the tire date codes.
Steering
Turn lock to lock and drive straight: no clunks, whine, wander or heavy spots, and no steering warning.
